notes.title: Top Gnome is fully Released!
notes.notes:
[p]After what was probably way too long, Top Gnome is finally ready to come out of Early Access! Bert is just as relieved as we are that this project is finally wrapping up, at least for the time being. As a team, we've learned a ton working on Top Gnome and we hope to transfer the skills and knowledge we've gained into our future projects. Top Gnome is just the beginning of what we want to do, and we look forward to showing you our new projects in the future! We want to thank everyone who supported us throughout Top Gnome's development, it would have been much harder without you!

Bert also gives his thanks!

Since we will be shifting our focus to our next game, we will be leaving Top Gnome in its fully released state for the foreseeable future outside of bug fixes/small patches. This isn't to say we won't revisit Top Gnome in the future, it just isn't the focus now. If you want to keep yourself up to date on our future games, join our discord!
[url="https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa"]https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa[/url][/p]

notes.title: Top Gnome is compatible with Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
While not officially verified for the Steam Deck, Top Gnome works very well on the Steam Deck, almost like it was made for it. This means you can gnome on the go!

Riding a train? You can gnome.
In a long line? You can gnome.
Waiting for your tax returns? You can Gnome!

Just don't gnome and drive, it's dangerous and reckless for your fellow non-gnoming drivers.

notes.title: A decision has been made.
notes.notes:
So, what did we decide?

First, what led to this decision.
Its not something that we ideally wanted to do, but its something we feel now that we have to do.
We believe in transparency always.
We are burnt out, we rushed the demo out under tight time constraints. And we have been taking a break, because working from 9 am to 12am was really taking a toll. 

Our internal release date is set for November 20th, and we now don't have the time to put everything we want in the game at the standard we expect from ourselves.

We tossed around several ideas including cutting content to make the deadline. 
I and my partner (the coder) don't want to cut things or add stuff in updates later after the game was supposed to be already released.

So, we have decided to go early access. 
For a developer it is a risky move.
There are several benefits and drawbacks to doing this.

One of the best things about early access is the connection to the people that like Top Gnome, as it is not the kind of game that a lot of people around us like. 
Operating in a bubble has been very hard on us, and the chance for feedback from people that really like the game would be a wonderful change, and would help us make it even better.

The downside is that it wont be perfect yet, there will be bugs and some issues, and this could negatively affect us.

We will continue with our regular updates through out the process, and will answer questions both here and on discord.

The game will not be forever in early access! 
As a gamer myself, I really dislike when developers do that. 
We do have an end goal, and the game shouldn't be in early access for too long. 

We are hoping to keep the same release date however we need to work with Steam first for early access to know for sure.
We will keep you updated as things progress.

Don't forget to join the discord and get involved! 
https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa

notes.title: The Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hello all, September has been a busy month for us and Top Gnome as we have been gearing up for Steam Next Fest this October! We've been pushing hard to get Top Gnome demo ready for you all to finally play. We've been itching (Bert included) to see what everyone thinks, and we want to hear feedback on your experience with Top Gnome's Demo.

We have also decided to introduce a new mechanic called Trinkets to spice things up. Trinkets can be bought from the shop for cheap, and give unique bonuses that can be upgraded if you can find and catch the illusive Rosetta Scarabs. While you only start with one trinket slot, you will be able to unlock more as you play through the game.

Overall this month has been incredibly productive and while we wait for Next Fest, here is a summary of what got done this month (We may have forgotten to list some things):
[list]
[*] Added a new trinket system that will give bonuses depending on what you choose to equip
[*] Added a menu to list all the new trinkets
[*] You can now cycle through potions you pick up
[*] Shop now has full functionality
[*] Button prompts will now show up over their corresponding actions, and will match your key bind settings and controller type
[*] Added potion and button drops from enemies
[*] Added Rosetta Scarabs
[*] Re-balanced the difficulty of early-mid waves
[*] The map and bullet select screen got a makeover
[*] The game now concludes at wave 15
[*] Added a continue feature that will save your progress from an unfinished run
[*] A whole bunch of polish with both menus and in-game
[*] Lots of bug fixes (They never end)
[*] Small performance improvements (Ongoing process)
[/list]

That about wraps up this month's update. There is still tons of work we need to do to get things ready, so we need to get back on top of that.

Make sure to join the discord if you haven't already!
https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa

notes.title: The potions update
notes.notes:
Another month, another update!

This month has been focused primarily on the content and meat of the game, as well as little bits of polish that makes the game feel good to play. We added several new bullet types and are about a third of the way through adding in potions and their effects. What's a potion you may ask?

Well, potions in Top Gnome serve as the game's powerups. As you play through the game and collect the game's currency (Buttons!), you will be able to buy these powerups as well as the different types of bullets. We wanted each potion to have a unique effect that makes them stand out from one another, and hold the design philosophy that potions must give back some form of control back to the player given the game's mechanics. If you want to see how the shop looks, you can look back to our previous monthly update to see the shop art!

Hey, it's the programmer here! We decided this month to have the news be more of a personal update. I have decided to quit my job to pursue finishing this project full time so that we can get it done before the end of the year.

notes.title: Godot port update
notes.notes:
Good news! Our decision to port to Godot was good. Due to the differences in the engines we are able to add things to the game that we wanted but weren't possible in Unity.
This is exciting for us as these additions have spawned more ideas, and we feel the game will be much better because of it. The port is starting to speed up because we are becoming more familiar with the engine. Our hope is that we can recoup our lost time, and get back on track with our original time line.

We will be working to keep you informed from now on with at least 1 update a month on development. You can join our discord for more information and regular development updates as well as specific details on new additions. 

Discord link: https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa

notes.title: Top Gnome and Unity
notes.notes:
Hello, some of you may or may not know that we were building our game, Top Gnome in Unity. Due to the recent monetization changes they have made, we have made the hard decision to port our game over to Godot. We don't yet know the extent of how this will affect our studio. This change has cost us time and trust, because of this we don't feel that it is financially stable to continue our business with Unity.
We hope that this doesn't push back our timeline for release and we'll keep everyone updated going forward.
